notes: Large-source-unit check: `אֲשֶׁר … שָׁמָּה` → *whither* is one discontinuous fused unit — the single word carries the relation, the resumption and the direction — headed on the relative (rules 22, 30, 32).
`מִשְׁלַח` is recast as *that thou puttest … unto*; the supplied relative and subject pronoun join the noun's unit because no morpheme in the clause licenses them (rule 46).
The ASV renders `הַנָּכְרִי` indefinitely, so the assimilated article is `unrepresented` and the *a* belongs to the noun (rules 29, 15).
